title: SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究
summary: 以高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界解析SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore SPARC high-field tokamak research through hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.
v30Focus: 高溫超導高場托卡馬克的定量檢核：磁場四次方定標、安匝數、超導帶材與模型線圈試驗
v30FocusEn: Quantitative checks of a high-field tokamak with high-temperature superconductors: fourth-power field scaling, ampere-turns, tape supply and the model coil test

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究案例中比較緊湊tokamak幾何與預期Q與設施邊界，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate compact tokamak geometry and projected q/facility boundaries within the SPARC high-field tokamak research case.

steps.title: 約束方式與系統邊界：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Confinement and system boundaries: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對緊湊tokamak幾何提出可反駁的約束方式與系統邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable confinement and system boundaries model and evidence record for compact tokamak geometry.
steps.instruction: 在「SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識緊湊tokamak幾何。磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 建立約束方式與系統邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify compact tokamak geometry in the mentor diagram and primary sources for SPARC high-field tokamak research. Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of confinement and system boundaries, focusing on hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。
steps.observationEn: Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：達到研究目標就表示可直接售電。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A research milestone means electricity can immediately be sold.
steps.check: 提交緊湊tokamak幾何的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for compact tokamak geometry.

knowledge.title: 約束方式與系統邊界
knowledge.text: 磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 本課架構對應：緊湊tokamak幾何
knowledge.textEn: Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Course architecture correspondence: Compact tokamak geometry

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；達到研究目標就表示可直接售電。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: A research milestone means electricity can immediately be sold.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設融合輸出100 MW、指定等離子體加熱20 MW，Qplasma=5；若驅動電效率40%、熱電效率35%、其他輔機10 MW，假想淨電=100×0.35−20/0.40−10=−25 MW。忽略其他回收熱，說明Q>1不自動等於淨發電。
knowledge.textEn: Assume fusion output 100 MW and specified plasma heating 20 MW: Qplasma=5. With driver efficiency 40%, conversion 35% and auxiliaries 10 MW, assumed net=35−50−10=−25 MW. Other recovered heat is omitted; Q>1 does not ensure net electricity.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究」的「約束方式與系統邊界：架構分析」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源輸入、轉換、儲存、輔助負載與有用輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「能源站：把損失算回來」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的能源表、儲能狀態、損失項及設備範圍的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Confinement and system boundaries: architecture analysis” in “SPARC high-field tokamak research”. Draw the energy input, conversion, storage, auxiliary loads and useful-output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Energy Station: Account for the Losses” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for same-window energy accounts, storage state, loss terms and equipment boundary, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for confinement and system boundaries in compact tokamak geometry?

達到研究目標就表示可直接售電。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant.
A research milestone means electricity can immediately be sold.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

quiz.explanationEn: Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries.

steps.title: 約束方式與系統邊界：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Confinement and system boundaries: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對緊湊tokamak幾何提出可反駁的約束方式與系統邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable confinement and system boundaries model and evidence record for compact tokamak geometry.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「約束方式與系統邊界」模型，檢查緊湊tokamak幾何的兩個假想案例。畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous confinement and system boundaries model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving compact tokamak geometry. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.check: 提交緊湊tokamak幾何的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.title: 加熱與能量增益：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Heating and gain: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對預期Q與設施邊界提出可反駁的加熱與能量增益模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable heating and gain model and evidence record for projected q/facility boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在「SPARC 高場 tokamak 研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識預期Q與設施邊界。等離子體或target的增益只比較指定輸入輸出；全設施需另計供電、轉換與損失。 建立加熱與能量增益的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是高溫超導磁體與緊湊裝置能量邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開Q、驅動效率、熱電效率與淨電的假想預算。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify projected q/facility boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for SPARC high-field tokamak research. Plasma/target gain compares specified inputs/outputs; facilities also need electrical/conversion losses. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heating and gain, focusing on hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate Q, driver efficiency, conversion efficiency and assumed net power. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 分開Q、驅動效率、熱電效率與淨電的假想預算。
steps.observationEn: Separate Q, driver efficiency, conversion efficiency and assumed net power.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Q大於1就保證全廠淨髮電大於0。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Q above one guarantees positive plant net electricity.
steps.check: 提交預期Q與設施邊界的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for projected q/facility boundaries.
